description: Bounded source-record diagnosis on two exact bundled, still-unscored Classic fan members. No win, score, ruleset change or parity claim.
baselinePhaseSweep: Uniform source input phases minus eight through plus eight under Original and Golems mechanics and native versus all-32 object semantics.

diagnosis: The source page and bundled headers agree on goal, total count, release rate and skill stock. The first source Builder needs a plus-four native phase to be accepted. The later Builder is rejected because lemming 5 has already fallen out on the tested route. Moving that Builder alone does not restore eligibility; some earlier action or terrain/physics state must change. Moving the preceding Basher permits 40 fully accepted replays, but all save 0/69. On The Long Way Around, 40 phase candidates accept all actions yet save 0/45. These observations separate input translation or source-state differences from a simple lack of wider beam search, but do not isolate an engine defect.
